# Glow Guy Detailing

> Mobile car detailing in the Niagara Region and Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. We come to the client's home or office. Interior detailing, full details, machine polishing and ceramic coating. Exact price by vehicle size, confirmed in writing before the appointment.

## Packages (sedan prices; SUV/truck +$25–50, 3-row/large +$50)

- Winter Salt Rescue: from $99 (Nov–Apr) — hot-water extraction of road salt from carpets and mats, interior vacuum and wipe-down, 1.5–2 hours.
- Interior Reset: $150 — full vacuum, hot-water extraction of seats and carpets, salt and stain treatment, dash/console/vents, interior glass, 2–3 hours.
- Full Glow: $230 — everything in Interior Reset plus foam hand wash, wheels and tires, door jambs, exterior glass, spray sealant, 3–4 hours.
- Showroom + Sealant: $320 — everything in Full Glow plus clay-bar decontamination, one-step machine polish, 12-month sealant, engine-bay detail, 5–6 hours.
- Machine polishing: one-step from $250; two-step correction from $450; headlight restoration $80/pair.
- Ceramic coating: 2-year from $450; 5-year from $650; premium/lifetime from $900.
- Add-ons: pet hair +$40, engine bay $60, clay bar +$30, odour removal +$50, leather conditioning +$40.

## How booking works

1. Customer sends 2–3 photos of the car by text or WhatsApp.
2. They receive one fixed price in writing, usually within one business hour.
3. We detail at their home or office on the chosen day.

## Service area

St. Catharines, Niagara Falls, Welland, Hamilton, Stoney Creek, Grimsby, Niagara-on-the-Lake, Thorold, Fonthill (Ontario, Canada). Open 7 days a week, 8:00–20:00.
